text: By the institution of our ancestors, it was wisely provided that the young should learn from the old, not only by precept, but by their own observation, how to behave in that sphere in which they were one day themselves to move; while these, again, in their turn, transmitted the same mode of instruction to their children.
author: Pliny the Younger
translation: William Melmoth, rev. F. C. T. Bosanquet
